{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Verify premise: customer_age contains -1 as sentinel
sentinel_count = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f'Number of -1 values in customer_age: {sentinel_count}')

# Verify premise: data includes six internal QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_count = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
print(f'Number of rows with revenue = 999999.99: {qa_count}')

# Verify premise: data includes refunded orders
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# Compute mean age, excluding -1 sentinels
valid_age_df = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]
mean_age = valid_age_df['customer_age'].mean()
print(f'Mean age of customers (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f}')"}
